name: Russia–NATO
value: Drone in Polish airspace 23 Nov; no Article 4
summary: Russian drone entered Polish airspace 23 Nov; Finland says a Russian helicopter may have crossed its border on 21 Nov
state: A Russian drone briefly entered Polish airspace late on 23 Nov while Russia struck western Ukraine; Poland authorised a shoot-down but held fire when it turned east, and NATO agreed to send an AWACS aircraft to Poland (ABC News via Yahoo). Finland said a Russian helicopter may have entered its airspace off Loviisa on 21 Nov and summoned Russia's ambassador, after three Kh-101 missiles fell in Poland on 19–20 Nov (Euromaidan Press). No Article 4 request was found, so Watch holds.
for_you: Repeated airspace violations on NATO's eastern flank raise the risk of incidents. Travellers to the region should follow FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: Drone and airspace violations on NATO territory; no Article 4 or clash

sources.title: ABC News via Yahoo — Russian drone flies into Poland during overnight strikes on Ukraine, Warsaw says
Euromaidan Press — Kh-101s, a helicopter, and drones: five days of airspace incidents on NATO's and Moldova's edges

why: Direct Russia–NATO confrontation is the most likely path to a European war involving the UK.
drivers: Airspace and drone incursions, sabotage, Baltic incidents, nuclear signalling, Ukraine war spillover.

rubric.alert: Article 4 consultations, a direct military clash, or an attack on NATO territory.
rubric.watch: Airspace/drone violations, sabotage attributed to Russia, or explicit threats against members.
rubric.normal: No notable incidents on NATO territory in the past two weeks.
